objective: Owner request: make swords in Blender and fix how they are held. Hero rebuilds of the katana, kodachi and nodachi, a saya per weapon, one legendary blade per top Blade Art, and a natural guard hold on R15 and R6 with a real second blade for Twin Kodachi.
inputs: Studio screenshots of the old hold
acceptance_criteria: katana, kodachi and nodachi stay within 3000 tris with a curved blade, kissaki, shinogi, hamon, habaki, seppa, tsuba per weapon, same panels, diamond ito, menuki and kashira, at the same overall height as the old models
<weapon>_saya exists per weapon with koiguchi, kojiri, kurikata and sageo cord
blade_inferno, blade_lightning, blade_void, blade_galaxy, blade_gold and blade_shadow replace only the blade and land on the habaki on all three weapons
The hand closes on the middle of the tsuka, offset from the Handle's measured length, for hero models and the part fallback; the blade points forward and up with the edge away from the player
Twin Kodachi shows a blade in each hand that sweep together, on R15 and R6
The saya shows on the left hip only while the sword is held, on R15 and R6
New assets have nil ids until uploaded and the game runs without them
docs/assets/register.md has a Pending upload row per new asset
verification: lune run tests/run, selene src tests, stylua --check, rojo build night.project.json, node tools/validate-tasks.mjs; review build/blender/night/swords_sheet.png and build/blender/night/grip_shots/; after the upload run, playtest Night with the generated NightAssets.luau
notes: Roblox ignores Color on a textured MeshPart, so the hamon is thin Neon geometry (<weapon>_glow), not a blade texture. Upload the heroes and art blades in one run: art blades line up using the new models' root values. No animation assets added: the hold uses Tool.Grip, the built-in tool animations and a mirrored left arm.
